messages:
janel: Quick proposal: collapse route_events + route_metrics into console_telemetry_v2 to serve dashboard queries from a single partitioned table. Draft migration PR shortly.

rahul: Why v2 instead of materialized views?

janel: Two reasons: 1) current joins are the perf bottleneck for p95 on big customers; 2) v2 gives us tighter control over partitions/retention. Views still hit multiple underlying tables.

minh: Backfill size estimate?

janel: ~280M rows across daily partitions, ~120GB compressed. Backfill time ~3-5 days at low throttle.

cora: Big red flag: we must not impact upstream ingest. How will we do this without locking PG?

janel: Plan: 1) enable dual-write under FF (console.telemetry_v2) 2) run a paused, token-throttled backfill that copies by tenant_bucket and day windows 3) add a shadow-read flag for verification. No table locks.

rahul: Dual-write needs idempotency. Use uuid(route_id, event_ts, source) as primary key or an upsert with last_seen.

janel: Agree. We'll use deterministic natural key: (route_id, event_minute, origin_tag). Upserts use ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING to remain idempotent.

minh: Can the backfill be interrupted and resumed safely?

janel: Yes, state is stored in migration_jobs table with chunk status and TTL so aborted jobs don't pile up. Each chunk marks start/end and checksum.

migrator-bot: MIGRATION PR 5123 created by janel: https://git.internal/redwood/PR/5123 10 includes backfill worker, token bucket throttler, FF gating.

cora: Monitoring: we need a compare job that samples stats from v1 vs v2 for traffic sent to canary tenants. Sample at route-level: count, avg_latency, p95_tokens.

janel: Yep. We'll ship a compare pipeline that emits delta metrics to a dedicated dashboard. Thresholds: count delta < 0.5%, latency delta < 3%. If exceeded, auto-disable FF and stop writes.

rahul: Canary plan? Start with internal dev org -> unmanaged small tenants -> paid small -> big tenants over 7 days. Each ramp step at least 12h.

janel: Proposed schedule: canary window Tue 14:00 UTC (2h), then 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 7 days. Rollback points after each step.

minh: Index parity checklist: ensure v2 includes indexes for (route_id, event_minute), (tenant_id, event_minute), and a GIN on tags. Also partition by event_day for easy TTL.

janel: Added to checklist. Also planning a compacted aggregate table for the console's heavy queries so we don't hit raw telemetry for p99 dashboards.

cora: Add SRE kill-switch: if DB cpu > 65% or console p95 > threshold, backfill auto-pauses and dual-write stops. Ops must be paged.

janel: Will add circuit-breaker. Also scheduling a 30m sync with SRE tomorrow 09:30 PT to walk the playbook.

rahul: One more compatibility item: the console query layer must support both shapes. Add an adapter that inspects FF and rewrites queries to v2, with feature-flagged safe-fallback. Keep the SQL abstraction in a single place.

janel: We'll introduce telemetry_store.v2_read(path) helper and deprecate old code after 2 weeks.

minh: Performance test: run read-only load test from canary cluster against v2 with synthetic high-cardinality tags to exercise GIN. Share results before ramp.

janel: I'll schedule perf run and post results to the PR.

migrator-bot: SCHEDULED: perf-run job 5056795000 -> 5056798600.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started to canary region.

rahul: Don't forget runbook entries: rollback steps, how to regenerate migration chunks, how to verify checksums, and cost estimate for backfill.

janel: Adding to PR: runbook + rollback script + SQL snippets. Example snippet for chunked copy:
```sql
INSERT INTO console_telemetry_v2 (route_id, event_minute, origin_tag, payload)
SELECT route_id, date_trunc('minute', ts) as event_minute, origin_tag, payload
FROM route_events
WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND ts >= $2 AND ts < $3
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
```

cora: LGTm with the safety gates. Please ensure FF timelines and ramp timers are explicit in PR.

janel: Will do. Plan to merge PR after canary if perf looks good. Thanks everyone.

migrator-bot: MIGRATION NOTE: next step -> staged ramp 10% (5056830000) then 50% (5056900000).
